name: when-benchmarks-talk
description: A Hugging Face dataset that collects examples for evaluating models' judgments about benchmarking decisions and/or temporal/contextual claims about benchmarks. It contains text instances (prompts and responses) meant to test whether models can correctly answer when or under what conditions particular benchmarks apply. The dataset is aimed at meta-evaluation of model reasoning about benchmarks rather than domain-specific knowledge.
evaluation_method: accuracy (or correctness of chosen justification); may also use human_eval for nuanced answers
reputation: A relatively small, niche Hugging Face dataset with limited visibility and adoption in the wider community.
